name: rust-monorepo-orchestrator
description: Methodology-first multi-agent refactoring orchestrator for monorepos. Spawns parallel waves of Opus-orchestrated, Sonnet-implemented subagents that drill a domain top-to-bottom (HTTP commands -> events -> views -> inter-service events), document architecture violations, author project-specific ast-grep rules, then run a wave of isolated-worktree workers with claim-lock concurrency, automerge on verifier-pass, and dead-letter on failure. Two wave runners: /run-wave dispatches a long-lived wave-orchestrator subagent; /run-wave-ralph drives the same lifecycle via a bash Ralph loop spawning claude -p per worker (no nested-Agent dispatch, full disk-resumability, live monitor via scripts/monitor-wave.sh). Filesystem inbox; HANDOFF.md cross-phase contract; subagent memory; auto-loaded prompting and orchestration skills. Stack-agnostic by design -- the rules are authored per project, not shipped by the plugin. Eight slash commands (/init, /audit-domain, /plan-refactor, /run-wave, /run-wave-ralph, /status, /replay, /sweep-rules), nine subagents, three methodology skills.
